rule_or_requirement: The pixel policy must learn a higher-speed action before faster valid completions can be assessed.
observable_information: TRAIN-only pixels, simulator speed labels, rollout gas and brake, PPO losses and policy-head parameter changes.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Initialize two fresh optimizers from the same immutable v2 actor and change only the policy-mean optimizer learning rate in one TRAIN-only arm.
expected_success_endpoint: Higher policy-head rate increases learned gas on the fixed TRAIN protocol without hiding finish or damage regressions; later matched TUNE remains a separate decision.
control: Same actor, seed, TRAIN split, steps, action range and base learning rate with policy-mean learning rate 2e-6.
falsifier: Candidate late-rollout gas mean fails to exceed control by 0.02 or policy-head change is not larger; instability and reduced valid finishes are reported separately.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Two sequential 4096-decision TRAIN runs, 4 PPO updates each, with policy-mean learning rates 2e-6 and 2e-4 respectively.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux Python 3.11 CPU, at most 3600 seconds per arm, train-only split, no tune or official site actions.
